ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, registered agent principals and commercial counterparties against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU CFSP Sanctions List, and VFSC enforcement notices; mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members and close associates, including verification of source of wealth and source of funds; suspicious transaction reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) within statutory timeframes; ongoing transaction monitoring and risk-based periodic re-screening.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Company Registry Online e-Search and Name Clearance Desk
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Roman/Latin characters. Official languages of Vanuatu (Bislama, English and French) are accepted; where a foreign-script name is proposed, an approved transliteration or phonetic equivalent is mandatory. The name must end with a statutory suffix: Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Incorporated, or the French equivalent Societe Anonyme, or a recognised abbreviation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Following a name rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies at the VFSC within 14 calendar days, annexing a name-conflict search report and supporting declarations; the VFSC shall render a decision within 5 business days. An adverse decision may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act. In parallel, a second-choice alternative name should be reserved to mitigate delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable: a virtual or administrative office address may serve as the registered office, provided the International Company maintains a VFSC-licensed registered agent with a physical office in Vanuatu. No domestic business premises or physical manufacturing site are required for an offshore International Company; heparin fractionation and related commercial operations may be conducted outside Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 15% annual probability for a purely offshore, non-regulated International Company; approximately 45% annual probability if a Vanuatu pharmaceutical or trading licence is obtained. The VFSC may conduct unannounced compliance inspections of the registered agent's premises and records; foreign production sites are not customarily inspected.

incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: International Company Incorporation Application (Form IC-1) together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account requirement. Any issued share capital is fixed by the Articles and may be paid in such currency as the Board determines.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the incorporation application as presented to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission is ratified and the Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted. RESOLVED that the subscriber's allotment of the initial shares be and is hereby confirmed, and the registered office at the address notified to the VFSC is established. RESOLVED that [Name] be and is hereby appointed as Director, [Name] as Company Secretary, and [Name] as Principal Officer for the purposes of the International Companies Act. RESOLVED that the Directors are authorised to file the statutory declaration of compliance, pay all fees, and open corporate bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name availability search and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Online Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for the exact international company name, including the required corporate suffix 'International Company' or 'IC'. Payment of the VFSC name reservation fee is made online. The certificate of reservation is issued for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation form
Applicant passport copy
Name reservation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused because it is identical or confusingly similar to an existing name, submit a fresh request with 2 to 3 alternative proposed names and pay only the fee per new name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association, declarations of data on directors, shareholders, secretary, registered office, and share structure. The incorporator and subscribers execute the documents, and the agent certifies due execution.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of each subscriber's passport
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, not older than 3 months)
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Completed shareholder, director, officer and secretary registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries any missing or illegible supporting document, the agent must resubmit the corrected packet within 5 business days or the reservation lapses; a corrected submission is not treated as a new application where the name is still reserved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application and statutory declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, International Companies and Limited Partnerships Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed agent submits Form IC-1 electronically or in hard copy, together with the constitutional documents, registered office consent, registered agent consent, and the statutory declaration of compliance executed by the agent.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 signed by the agent
Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed)
Consent and appointment of registered agent
Consent to use registered office address
Statutory declaration of compliance under section 12(2) of the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or deficiency notice, the agent has 14 days to file a corrective submission. Failure to cure within that period results in a deemed refusal; a new Form IC-1 and fresh filing fee will be required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of government incorporation and filing fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the VFSC incorporation fee and stamp duty (where applicable) via bank transfer or VFSC payment platform. The VFSC processes only complete applications with cleared payment.
required_dossiers: VFSC fee payment slip
Copy of approved name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not applied within 3 business days, request a payment reallocation remittance confirmation from the bank. If the fee schedule has changed, pay the outstanding difference before release of the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation, register maintenance and first board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, International Companies and Limited Partnerships Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfying the Registry, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent then requires the board to pass the pro forma first board resolution, open statutory registers, and file an initial return if any.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Pro forma first board resolution
Register of Directors
Register of Members
Register of Charges (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the physical certificate is defective, submit a written request with the original certificate for reissuance; the VFSC corrects clerical errors without a fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation operational license and permit initiation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Health, VFSC Business License Desk, VEPA and Vanuatu Police Fire and Emergency Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the business license, pharmaceutical manufacturing facility license, environmental permit, and fire safety clearance. File all application forms together with the Certificate of Incorporation, site drawings, and safety management plans.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent certificate
Business license application form
Pharmaceutical manufacturing license application
Environmental permit application and EIA scoping report
Facility floor plan and fire safety design
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a permit application is queried, respond in writing to the specific agency within the stated curing period. Requests for supplemental environmental or occupational health studies can be submitted as addenda to the original application; no new application is required unless the permit is deemed void.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Health - Department of Health and Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Business Licensing Desk
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Facility License under the Medicines Act [Cap. 96] and Vanuatu Business License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Environmental Protection Agency (VEPA), Ministry of Climate Change, Environment, Energy and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A - Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) report required for pharmaceutical chemical processing and heparin extraction facilities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Vanuatu Water Quality Standards 2017 and the Waste Management Regulations: wastewater total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L, COD ≤ 250 mg/L, pH 6.0-9.0; zero discharge of residual organic solvents including ethanol and perchloric acid; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions below 150 ppm; hazardous waste manifesting and disposal through VEPA-licensed contractors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Requires a fire safety clearance certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Emergency Services, structural load and building compliance certificate from the Ministry of Public Works, and an occupational health and workplace clearance under the Health and Safety at Work Act [Cap. 135] confirming adequate ventilation, chemical storage, and emergency response preparedness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official portal https://www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; customs declarations and clearance processed electronically via ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) via a VFSC-licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], obtaining Certificate of Incorporation, constitution, and registered office in Port Vila. Step 2: Confirm exemption status under Section 12 of the IC Act; a pure offshore IC making no supplies to Vanuatu residents is statutorily exempt from all present and future Vanuatu taxes and is not required to obtain a VRC TIN. Step 3: If the IC triggers domestic taxable activity or voluntarily elects VAT registration, apply to VRC for the national TIN through the VRC E-Services portal (single TIN covering VAT, customs, and business license); submit certificate of incorporation, constitution, registered agent certificate, director/shareholder due diligence documents, and power of attorney. Step 4: File the VRC VAT registration form within 21 days of the end of the month in which taxable turnover exceeds VT 5,000,000; a Vanuatu service address and local registered agent are mandatory for any VRC interaction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The Vanuatu IC is wholly exempt from income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, dividends tax, and stamp duty; Vanuatu imposes no direct taxes whatsoever. The IC is also prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents and from owning Vanuatu land, ensuring no domestic VAT nexus. VAT applies only to domestic taxable supplies; the offshore procurement and export of heparin crude or fractionated API remain outside the Vanuatu VAT net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, entity-classification, or hybrid-mismatch elections exist because Vanuatu has no income tax base. Available statutory elections: (i) voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 232] for persons making taxable supplies below the threshold, subject to VRC approval; (ii) election to treat a supply of services as exported and zero-rated where the recipient is a non-resident and the benefit of the services occurs outside Vanuatu, provided documentary evidence is retained; (iii) no election required for the IC Act tax exemption, which applies automatically; (iv) any future tax reform is subject to the IC Act grandfathering exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998, effective 1 August 1998, administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs; monthly returns due by the last day of the month following the tax period.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (approx. USD 42,000) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; compulsory registration within 21 days of the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded; voluntary registration available below threshold; the offshore IC normally remains below this nexus because domestic supplies are prohibited.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal e-invoicing, continuous transaction control, tax authority API clearance, or digital stamping mandate is in force in Vanuatu. VAT invoices are self-issued and must contain the minimum statutory particulars: supplier name and TIN, recipient name, invoice date, description, quantity, tax-exclusive price, and VAT amount. Customs exports must be declared electronically in ASYCUDA World with digital submission of the Single Administrative Document; no B2B e-invoicing integration with the tax authority is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Section 11 of the VAT Act, a registered supplier zero-rates goods that are exported from Vanuatu, provided the goods are physically exported within 28 days of the date of supply and the supplier holds prescribed export evidence; services supplied to non-residents are zero-rated where the services are performed outside Vanuatu or are directly connected to exported goods. For the heparin sodium anticoagulant trade (ISIC 3250), zero-rating covers: (i) direct export of the fractionated API from Vanuatu; (ii) triangular offshore resale where the IC never lands goods in Vanuatu and risk passes to the non-resident buyer abroad; and (iii) fractionation or blending services physically performed outside Vanuatu for foreign customers. The supplier must substantiate the 0% rate with customs, transport, and payment records; failure to export within 28 days or to retain evidence converts the supply to taxable at 12.5%. Note: Vanuatu has no exchange-control legislation, so no statutory FX repatriation deadline applies; the 180-day figure recorded in this dossier is the standard documentary benchmark applied by the compliance pipeline, not a Vanuatu legal requirement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World Single Administrative Document) evidencing export from Vanuatu
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill dated within 28 days of supply evidencing discharge at the foreign destination port
Commercial invoice with full description, quantity, unit price, Incoterms, purchaser TIN, and zero-rating statement
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 / Letter of Credit payment evidence confirming receipt from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC conducts post-clearance audits of zero-rated exporters and may require production of the complete export bundle; if the 28-day export window, documentary conditions, or residence of the recipient are not met, the supply is re-characterized as taxable at 12.5% with default assessment, interest, and penalty tax. Fraudulent or exaggerated zero-rating claims, including forged bills of lading, fictitious remittance certificates, or circular invoicing, constitute offences under the VAT Act and general criminal law, attracting substantial pecuniary penalties, imprisonment, retrospective clawback of VAT refunds for the entire audit period, and suspension or revocation of VAT registration; deliberate document forgery also triggers VFSC and Financial Intelligence Unit reporting obligations for the licensed registered agent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 322], is the monopoly issuer of the Vatu and the administrative arm of exchange control under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 67]; the Minister of Finance retains residual approval powers. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) concurrently registers the International Company (IC) and supervises the pharmaceutical licence for ISIC 3250. Payment and settlement system oversight is exercised by the RBV under the Payments and Settlement Systems Act No. 24 of 2009.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV is freely convertible for current-account transactions including trade settlements, dividends and fees, subject only to an authorized-dealer gateway. Capital-account transfers require RBV approval for domestic (non-IC) entities, but this regime is statutorily disapplied for International Companies: section 174 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] renders the Exchange Control Act inapplicable to the IC business, permitting unrestricted multi-currency accounts in USD, EUR, AUD, GBP and VUV. Profit remittance from the IC to its shareholders carries no VUV withholding tax and no RBV repatriation licence; the operative hurdle is commercial de-risking by correspondent banks rather than legal convertibility. Practical assessment: capital-account convertibility for the IC is effectively full, provided the registered agent and substance documentation are current.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a domestic Vanuatu exporter, the Exchange Control Act requires export proceeds to be received in Vanuatu through an authorized dealer within six months of shipment; there is no statutory fixed-receipt conversion ratio into VUV, and market-rate conversion is applied residually. For the International Company the surrender obligation is nil: under s.174 of the International Companies Act the IC is exempt from all exchange control directions, may retain 100% of heparin export proceeds in USD/EUR/AUD in a foreign-currency account, and no mandatory conversion into VUV is triggered. Non-contractual reporting still applies: physical importation of low-molecular-weight heparin crude into Vanuatu requires a customs import declaration under the Customs Act [Cap. 121], and any cash or bearer instrument movements above VUV 1,000,000 require declaration to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; these are AML-customs rules, not FX surrender rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD/VUV Operating Account with an escrow overlay sub-ledger for the heparin trade receivables
TotalCash USD/AUD/VUV Operating Account plus Import Letter of Credit and Trade Finance facility
Foreign-currency cheque and savings account for IC treasury cash parking
Retail/resident-oriented VUV account; not structured for offshore ICs or cross-border pharma trade
Legacy domestic lender after National Provident Fund stewardship; no current cross-border IC trade-finance product

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-TO-MEDIUM. Vanuatu has no domestic e-money institution (EMI) licensing class, so an offshore EMI cannot access VUV clearing rails; all operational settlement must transit through the RBV or an authorized dealer. UK FCA-authorised and EU/EEA EMIs will entertain the VU IC only under enhanced merchant-risk review and normally require a substantive banker reference from BSP or ANZ plus a 12-month trade history; Asia-Pacific MPIs (Singapore) generally decline VU tax-exempt ICOs due to correspondent-bank de-risking. Legal constraint: an EMI can hold funds only as electronic money, not as bank deposits, exposing the IC to insolvency subordination if the EMI fails. Recommended architecture: use an EMI solely as a collection gateway for client receivables, sweep balances daily to the BSP anchor account, and cap the cumulative EMI float at 30 days of operating burn.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No Vanuatu statute requires a director to appear physically at account opening for an IC. However, all three viable commercial banks (BSP, ANZ, BRED) apply enhanced due diligence to tax-exempt ICs dealing in pharmaceutical APIs, and in practice at least one director with signing authority must appear for a face-to-face compliance interview in Port Vila before the account is activated. Remote opening is permitted as a second-best pathway if the applicant supplies a notarised and Apostille-certified passport, a notarised board resolution, the VFSC company extract, a registered-agent certificate and evidence of source of wealth; the bank will then conduct a live video interview and may still require a physical visit within 90 days. Budget for in-person KYC clearance at BSP Port Vila plus a videoconference backup at ANZ to avoid onboarding slippage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore IC status flagged as a potential shell or conduit, exacerbated by legacy bearer-share references in corporate registry searches
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation, current registered agent certificate, complete register of directors and shareholders with full beneficial-ownership names and passports, audited financial statements of the direct parent, a physical office lease in Port Vila, a group organisational chart, and a written commercial-substance statement describing the heparin fractionation offtake contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Heparin/API trading classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced with possible dual-use or controlled-substance scrutiny on crude biological material
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vanuatu Ministry of Health pharmaceutical import-export licence, valid GMP and ISO 13485 certificates of the ultimate manufacturer, the U.S. FDA or EDQM registration of the source heparin crude plant, end-customer attestation letters for the final anticoagulant use, a chain-of-custody dossier from slaughterhouse to fractionation site, and export permits from the source country.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity trade flows with low-information counterparties, e.g., pre-registered suppliers in China, India or the EU, triggering sanctions and PEP screening hits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed and stamped sales/purchase contracts, a complete KYC pack of each material counterparty (registration, directors, ultimate beneficial owners), the IC's 12-month bank statements evidencing established trade volume, corporate sanctions and PEP screening outputs, independent inspection certificates (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Eurofins), and a documentary-credit settlement pattern.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual treasury structuring: large third-party advances, intercompany loans from non-bank financiers, or rapid round-tripping through VUV-denominated accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed shareholder loan agreements, a source-of-wealth statement for each contributor, notarised gift or loan declarations, a copy of the s.174 International Companies Act exemption position letter, an RBV acknowledgment receipt where relevant, and an audited funds-flow trail from the ultimate shareholder's bank in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder equity via SWIFT MT103 from the parent's regulated bank to the IC's USD account at BSP Port Vila or ANZ Port Vila; the receiving bank requires the payment narrative to state CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES ACT S174 with a board resolution and share-issue documentation attached. Intercompany operational funding will be remitted as SHAREHOLDER LOAN INTERCOMPANY with an executed loan agreement, informing the bank that the transaction is exempt from exchange control. There is no RBV pre-approval for IC inbound capital; however, the bank must complete a customer risk assessment before the first credit, and any single wire above USD 1,000,000 equivalent will trigger a balance-of-payments statistical report to the RBV. For trade-related injections from an offtaker, use the purpose narration ADVANCE PAYMENT AGAINST PURCHASE ORDER and attach the purchase order; never describe the payment as a gift to avoid unintended tax or AML reclassification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred rail for crude heparin supplier settlement is a commercial documentary Letter of Credit issued by BSP under ICC UCP 600, transmitted via SWIFT MT700 from the issuing bank and settled by MT103/MT202 COV to the beneficiary's confirming bank, protecting against cargo and quality disputes. For repeat suppliers with an established relationship, direct MT103 payments with the supplier contract reference, commercial invoice, packing list and airway bill or bill of lading attached are acceptable. A documentary collection (MT400) is a viable fallback for mid-value shipments where the LC cost is unjustified. Exclude cash, cryptocurrency, or un-hosted virtual-asset bridges from the payment architecture, as these sever the evidentiary chain and strongly corrode bank relationships. Anticipate same-day BSP domestic clearing for VUV tails and one-to-two-day intermediary banking for USD wires via New York correspondents; hold a USD settlement buffer in the IC account to avoid failed SWIFT cover.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore plain-vanilla VUV/USD spot and one-week value-dated trades through RBV authorized dealers (BSP, ANZ, BRED); no dealer publishes a liquid VUV forward curve.

Offshore non-deliverable VUV forwards (NDFs) arranged by an Australian or New Zealand bank trading desk for amounts above USD 2,000,000 equivalent, with a VUV/USD fix referencing the RBV mid-rate as the settlement benchmark.

Cross-currency swaps on the USD funding leg only, executed via an offshore broker in AUD/USD or EUR/USD, with net settlement in a regulated GFSC or FMA jurisdiction; VUV-versus-USD swap is not available domestically.

USD/CNY deliverable forwards or NDFs layered through a Hong Kong or Singapore treasury centre to hedge the Chinese source-manufacturer costs, while natural hedging is accomplished by denominating the heparin offtake contract in USD.

Interest-rate hedging on the LC discounting facility using simple fixed-to-floating swaps with the confirming bank; commodity price risk on heparin crude is mitigated through minimum and maximum forward-pricing clauses in the supplier contract rather than exchange derivatives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; 30-day grace period after the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission attracts the prescribed VFSC administrative penalty for each month of default; a default continuing for three consecutive months from the due date places the International Company on the Registrar's strike-off list, whereupon the company is dissolved by Gazette notice and its property vests in the VFSC until restoration is ordered by the court.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee for Tax-Exempt Status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Division, paid through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; no statutory grace period unless extended by VFSC circular
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid renewal fee after 60 days incurs an additional penalty of 10% of the unpaid fee; after 90 days of non-payment the Registrar may strike the company off the register, with restoration only through a court application, payment of all arrears and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent's Annual Compliance Certificate and UBO/KYC Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC – AML/CFT Division via the licensed registered agent; certificate retained with statutory registers at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the Annual Return within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure of the registered agent to file or maintain the annual certificate is a licensing breach under the VFSC Regulatory Authority Act; the agent is liable to an administrative fine and suspension, and the company may be treated as non-compliant for strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard International Company. The International Companies Act does not require the appointment of a statutory auditor, the preparation of annual financial statements, or the filing of accounts, irrespective of turnover or asset thresholds. A mandatory audit can arise only if the company voluntarily elects in its articles, obtains a financial services license, or enters a contractual covenant requiring audited IFRS statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Vanuatu local GAAP is prescribed for International Companies. Financial statements produced voluntarily should follow IFRS or IFRS for SMEs; accrual accounting is the accepted basis for any lender or investor-facing presentation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu does not operate a public beneficial-ownership register for International Companies under the International Companies Act. The licensed agent must obtain and record natural-person beneficial ownership at account opening and annually confirm that information. Each share transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members and must be notified to the registered agent immediately so that the agent can refresh its UBO records; if a transfer changes the UBO, the agent's annual confirmation filed with VFSC must reflect the corrected ownership position before the 30-day annual return deadline.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – 2,000 per year depending on the corporate services provider and nominee-director requirements
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; if an audit is voluntarily engaged, typical certified audit fees for an active pharma-extraction intermediate holding/operating company range from USD 4,000 to 8,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu has no corporate income tax in force; International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempted by section 101 of the International Companies Act Cap 222 (exemption from all Vanuatu taxes).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent zero effective rate for an IC: no CIT, no capital gains tax, no branch profit tax, no withholding taxes and no stamp duty on transfers of heparin IP assets held in the IC. The sole recurring public charge is a fixed VFSC annual maintenance fee (a licence fee, not income tax) based on authorised capital; the fee schedule is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No CIT return exists in Vanuatu law - the Revenue and Customs Act (Cap 280) and the Tax Administration Act are not fiscal statutes covering IC income; the VFSC e-portal is used only to pay the IC annual maintenance fee and receive the certificate. No tax computation, no profit and loss schedule and no information return is lodged for ICs.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable - zero filing frequency for tax purposes.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No statutory CIT filing deadline because no return exists; the IC's exemption remains effective until the company is deregistered for unpaid VFSC fees or is dissolved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A declaration by the registered agent that the IC is an international company protected by the section 101 exemption and has not transacted with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners do not obtain a Vanuatu tax ID and are not admitted to the tax register; no income details of non-resident shareholders may be or should be filed with Vanuatu authorities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that dividends, interest and royalties paid by the IC carry a 0% Vanuatu withholding obligation, hence no remittance schedule is computable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The paying IC distributes without a VUV withholding voucher; the recipient should rely on home-country participation exemption or foreign tax credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu prescribes no transfer-pricing schedule, no related-party disclosure box and no country-by-country reporting for ICs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prepare OECD master and local files in the operating jurisdictions; the Vanuatu IC must obtain the same documents if the heparin manufacturing IP is held in it.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: As no CIT filing exists, no late-filing surcharge applies. Misuse of the exemption triggers the full domestic tax consequences: an IC transacting with Vanuatu residents or carrying on a domestic trade forfeits the section 101 exemption and becomes liable to the same charges applicable to domestic companies with effect from the date of the offending transaction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Fee and Re-registration acknowledgement - filed by the licensed registered agent on the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission electronic portal (offshore company maintenance system).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The maintenance fee is payable on or before 30 June of each year for the fee cycle 1 July to 30 June; late payments get a 30-day grace before penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name keyed against the Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC registry record.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners is required on the annual fee form; a simple confirmation by the registered agent suffices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the fee band (for example up to USD 10,000 or above USD 10,000 in authorised share capital).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital band determines the flat annual fee, not the profit; therefore the IC does not file accounts to support the band.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The agent confirms that the registered office and registered agent in Port Vila remain current and that the Heparin Sodium IP or asset holding purpose is within the permitted IC objects.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the IC becomes an ESR relevant-activity company, the agent will additionally flag the obligation to file the Economic Substance Return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment incurs a fixed penalty in the VFSC fee schedule plus an incremental monthly surcharge; failure to pay for 3 months leads to deregistration, loss of the certificate, legal personality suspension and difficulty reinstating the IC. Directors act at their own risk if they continue trading after strike-off.
